inspected_anchors: An exact finite-horizon signed continuation-residual identity uses reference occupancy and approximate continuation values under common policy, rewards and initial law.

Validation-law residual transport needs support and an explicit occupancy/L2 factor; a rare-history witness gives1USD validation error versus90USD policy error.
Known occupancies and separately fixed continuation values with genuine independent reference-row draws imply the stated simultaneous finite validation interval.
The longitudinal sum-of-radii budget objective has a conditional continuous2/3-power allocation; feasible integer rounding reduces the stipulated unequal-cost radius from35.1783 to31.4016USD.

limitations: Author review, not independent scientific acceptance.
Eight exact stipulated laws and dollar amounts; no new upstream-estimator execution, empirical coverage, bank observation or ROI.
Selected original files and inherited version/date records do not close the software census, full dependency rights or statistical/runtime qualification.
The older gfoRmula/ltmle/lmtp package declarations and separately acquired API bytes are content-bound; package-release and commit membership are not inferred from metadata alone.
The literature cutoff is2026-10-07; inherited mutable-snapshot and historical-cutoff limits are retained.
The natural-action witness deliberately violates strong innovation independence; the capped-shift witnesses omit endpoint regularity.
Uniform transition-error budgets and independent-trajectory sampling are explicit assumptions, not established properties of bank data.
Rendered visual acceptance remains false; inherited image allowance is exhausted.
Reference occupancy, support restrictions and independent reference transitions are explicit premises, not established bank facts.
The validation intervals are prospective designs; no new sample or measured coverage is reported.
Continuous optimality does not imply exact integer optimality or actual bank validation cost.
